question: What second-law (exergy) efficiency did the Aspen Plus simulation of hydrate-based CO2 capture in the hydrate CCUS review reach?
rendered: The second-law efficiency, which evaluates the potential of the system to convert the supplied energy into work, is slightly higher at 38.85% in this study.
